scientific_integrity: An exact finite exhaustive proof, with two fully standalone Python enumeration algorithms and conservative literature comparison; no claim of all-size ergodicity or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the labelled 4 by 4 toroidal square-ice system, 16 elementary faces, eight designated short winding loops and directed-cycle rejection are covered. General torus sizes, arbitrary loops, rates and mixing times are open. Historical equivalences might exist.
title: Sharp two-loop restoration of ergodicity in four-by-four square ice
